newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Electra still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Electra still a hold.

text.p: Sahar Securities and Investments has maintained its hold recommendation for Electra Consumer Products, saying the Israeli air conditioner maker will recover slowly from a weak 1996 fourth quarter.

"We anticipate an improvement in the company results only in the second quarter of 1997 and believe that the entire year will be influenced by the troubles of the preceding year," Sahar analyst Boaz Leviatan said in a report issued on Tuesday.

"This situation originates from the large inventories in the air conditioner sector and the weak results that are anticipated in commerce" by the company's wholly owned subsidiary Electra Trade which imports electrical appliances.
The report forecast an operating income of five million shekels in the first quarter of this year compared with 14 million shekels in the same period in 1996.
Electra had an operating loss of 16 million shekels in the fourth quarter of 1996 and a loss per share equal to 0.99 shekel compared with Sahar's forecast of a 0.57 shekel loss.

"Since the fourth quarter results serve to realise our fears regarding the company, in which we anticipate no significant improvement during the coming quarter, we are maintaining our hold recommendation for the company share," the report said.
Sahar said it was also maintaining its 17 to 20 shekel target price range for Electra shares for the coming year.
